note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: Google ordered to halt work on two data centers in 'Texas of Europe'
items.blurb: Finnish regulators told Google to pause two data center projects by Oct 23 until environmental reviews are complete.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: AI rally defies bond market rout
items.blurb: AI chip stocks carried the S&P 500 to a record close while Temasek warned an AI reversal is the market's biggest risk.

items.title: Trillions are being 'wasted' on the AI boom, Arthur Hayes says. He's betting on what comes next
items.blurb: The former BitMEX chief argues data-center spending will end in overcapacity and a crash, adding to investor doubts about the buildout.

items.title: Common Sense Media rates ChatGPT a safety risk for teens
items.blurb: Testers found parent-linked accounts received no alerts during hour-long conversations about self-harm and suicide.

items.title: Retrofitting language models to operate over bytes
items.blurb: A method converts existing language models to read raw bytes, improving character-level reasoning while keeping practical speeds.

items.title: Anthropic unveils a new, cheaper Haiku model
items.blurb: Anthropic's smallest model arrives at a fraction of its predecessor's price, pressing the cost race among low-end AI models.

items.title: Microsoft to sell $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra containing Nvidia AI chip
items.blurb: Microsoft and Nvidia are betting buyers will pay a premium to run demanding AI work on a laptop instead of the cloud.

items.title: Microsoft looks to reboot the AI PC with Nvidia
items.blurb: Microsoft is carving out a high-end laptop category for local AI, and Meta plans to bring its Muse agent to Windows.

items.title: IMF paper warns of hedge fund risks
items.blurb: An IMF paper flags hedge funds' heavy use of borrowed money in AI stocks as a risk to financial stability.

items.title: U.S. government, Google join Zuckerberg-backed Biohub in $1.8 billion push for AI biology data
items.blurb: Washington, Alphabet and Meta back open datasets for training biology models, lifting the nonprofit effort to $1.8 billion.

items.title: Meta needs Muse to become more than an AI novelty
items.blurb: Meta's personal agent tops app charts and lifted the stock, but keeping users after the novelty fades is the test.

items.title: Anthropic will be 'most ridiculous IPO' of year, analyst says
items.blurb: Research firm New Constructs says Anthropic's planned listing, reportedly seeking a $2 trillion valuation, poses a historic risk to markets.

items.title: World Bank warns of AI concentration risks as it lifts East Asia and Pacific growth outlook to 4.5%
items.blurb: The World Bank credits AI-related exports for stronger regional growth but warns a tech spending reversal would hit the region hard.

items.title: DeepSeek considers doubling latest funding round to up to $15 billion, sources say
items.blurb: DeepSeek may expand its round to 100 billion yuan, with Tencent and CATL among backers, ahead of a possible 2027 listing.

items.title: Trump rewrites midterm language on AI, affordability and Iran
items.blurb: The White House now calls AI "super intelligence" in official documents as polls show voters uneasy about the technology.

items.title: Mistral unveils new AI model it says rivals best open systems from China
items.blurb: Mistral previewed its largest model, with open weights due Oct 27; it still trails the leading closed models on coding.

items.title: "I don't want an oligopoly": New open-weight AI models mount a comeback against China
items.blurb: Reflection and Mistral are both releasing large open-weight models, challenging Chinese labs that dominate that category.

items.title: Meta Muse popularity lifts AMD stock to fresh highs as AI agents juice CPU sales
items.blurb: Demand for personal AI agents is shifting chip spending toward processors, lifting AMD and Intel shares.

items.title: Meta joins with group of companies to tame 'chaos' of doing business with AI bots
items.blurb: Meta, Walmart, Stripe and others published an open standard for how AI agents interact with businesses; OpenAI and Anthropic have not joined.

items.title: Anthropic expands Claude Startups program in bid to snag founders and fast-growing companies
items.blurb: Anthropic is offering startups up to $45,000 in discounts and credits, deepening its competition for young companies.

items.title: Google enters massive 3.6-GW power deal with Constellation Energy
items.blurb: Google contracts 3,590 megawatts from Constellation, including 890 from upgraded nuclear plants, with first deliveries expected in 2028.

items.title: Google squeezes more power from existing nuclear plants in Constellation deal. These stocks benefit
items.blurb: The 20-year agreement funds upgrades at 11 reactors in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey to feed data centers.

items.title: AI tools flood into underground cybercrime markets
items.blurb: Ads for AI hacking tools on Telegram and criminal forums rose from under 50 a month to more than 1,400.

items.title: Inside Trump's new AI playbook
items.blurb: A new White House task force has 120 days to reconcile divided Cabinet camps and recommend how federal agencies should regulate AI.
